performance_claim_scope: The bounded leaf screen is sufficient to reject runtime plumbing because the page-internal candidate loses producer-plus-reducer wall before conversion and loses by more after append plus complete live-cache conversion at every measured context. These are diagnostic rejection measurements, not a retained speedup claim.
correctness_claim_scope: The transient converter and attention specialization are byte-exact to the current layout on dense, permuted, and stale/evicted-unreferenced physical-page fixtures with complete KVLiveSpans position and eviction metadata.

blocking_reasons: Page-internal attention plus the unchanged reducer is slower than current token-major at all four contexts, including only 0.7562x at 32K and 0.7965x at 64K.
Charging append and complete live-cache conversion yields only 0.2766x at 32K and 0.2633x at 64K, far below the required 1.10x.
The ten-layer projection is a regression, not the required >=1% whole-decode saving.
The candidate raises producer VGPR from 72 to 80 despite zero LDS and scratch in both variants.
decision.production_disposition: Keep [block,token,kv_head,D] BF16 KV and the existing grouped-GQA producer/reducer. Do not rewrite writers, compactors, graph capture, or other KVLiveSpans consumers.
